basis: The quarter itself is weak: revenue fell 29% and gross loss widened to $24.5m. The new items are positive: a first data-center capacity reservation for 75 MW with an upfront payment, a new target of positive adjusted EBITDA in Q4 FY27, and $2.4bn of optional awarded backlog. On a high-beta story stock the data-center narrative should outweigh the print.
